Upscaling with Ultimate SD Upscale/Tile Controlnet SD Upscale & Anima Models

for the tile Controlnet
whith new node made byLebensignalu can use cntile with padding and seam fix features of USDU now.
参数：
- Prompt: Use the original image's prompt(when doing 1.5-3x upscale with low cn strength), or just quility and style prompt(when doing 3x+ upscale with high cn strength).
- Denoising Strength: Recommended range is 0.25 – 0.75.
- Steps: Adjust according to denoising strength, typically 8 – 20 steps.
- Sampler: er_sde is recommended.
- Controlnet strength: 0.4–1.0; Controlnet end at 0.8 - 1.0
- Plz download CN model from here:https://civitai.com/models/2708551

o.zh:
基于 Ultimate SD Upscale 或 Tile Controlnet 与 Anima 模型的放大工作流
Thanks@L_A_X








参数:
- 提示词：使用原图的提示词(1.5-3倍放大且使用低cn强度)或者只保留质量提示词和画风提示词(3倍以上放大且使用高cn强度)。
- 重绘幅度（Denoising Strength）：建议范围 0.25～0.75。
- 步数（Steps）：根据重绘幅度调整，通常为 8～20 步。
- 采样器（Sampler）：推荐使用 er_sde。
- ControlNet 强度（CN strength）：范围 0.4～1.0，结束位置在0.8-1.0.
- CN tile模型在这里下载:https://civitai.com/models/2708551
